    What happened to Vance on NCIS?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    In
    NCIS season 21, episode 7 ("A Thousand Yards"), Director Leon Vance was shot by a sniper while visiting his late wife's grave. Although critically injured, Vance survived, returned to duty, and featured in season 22 storylines focusing on his recovery, personal life, and strained relationship with his son, Jared. 
    Key Details on Director Vance: 
    • The Attack (Season 21): The 1000th episode featured the shooting, which forced Vance to take time off to recover and reflect on his safety and career.
    • Relationship with Son: The shooting strained his relationship with his son, Jared, who expressed concern over his father’s dangerous, high-pressure job.
    • Future in Season 22:
      Following the attack, Vance is shown navigating a new romantic relationship with a woman named Lena, leading to speculation that he may eventually prioritize his personal life over his role as Director.
    • Character Status: Despite the high-stakes injury, actor Rocky Carroll continues to play Vance, and the character is not leaving the show, according to reports during season 22.
    • Past Traumas: This incident followed the previous trauma of his wife, Jackie, being killed in season 10.
